rule.description: CI workflow 中的 vLLM 版本引用（commit hash、release tag）应集中在 `.commit` 文件中管理，避免在多个 workflow 文件中硬编码。

antipattern.code:
# （根据评审意见推断）读取 verified commit 的逻辑过于复杂
# wangxiyuan 评论: "just `_VLLM_MAIN_VERIFIED_COMMIT = 
# VLLM_MAIN_VERIFIED_COMMIT_PATH.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\").strip()` is enough IMO"
import os
from pathlib import Path

# -- Project information -----------------------------------------------------
project = "vLLM Ascend"
author = "vLLM Ascend Authors"

# -- General configuration ---------------------------------------------------
extensions = [
    "sphinx.ext.autodoc",
    "sphinx.ext.intersphinx",
    "sphinx.ext.napoleon",
]

# Verified vLLM main commit anchor file
VLLM_MAIN_VERIFIED_COMMIT_PATH = (
    Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
    / ".github"
    / "vllm-main-verified.commit"
)

# 读取逻辑过于复杂：先检查文件是否存在，再读取
_VLLM_MAIN_VERIFIED_COMMIT = None
if VLLM_MAIN_VERIFIED_COMMIT_PATH.exists():
    _VLLM_MAIN_VERIFIED_COMMIT = VLLM_MAIN_VERIFIED_COMMIT_PATH.read_text(
        encoding="utf-8"
    ).strip()

main_vllm_commit = _VLLM_MAIN_VERIFIED_COMMIT
